title: How John Ternus understood the assignment in the Apple launch event opener
summary: Newly minted Apple (AAPL) CEO John Ternus took the spotlight in the cinematic opener at the company's latest launch event, his predecessor Tim Cook handing the torch off in front of the audience. Creative Strategies CEO and principal analyst Ben Bajarin comes on Market Domination to talk about Ternus' presentation and how he represented Apple's core ideals.

title: Foldable iPhone Duo's software helps it 'shine' against competitors
summary: Apple's (AAPL) new CEO John Ternus unveiled the tech company's latest product — the foldable iPhone Duo — at a launch event on Wednesday. Creative Strategies CEO and principal analyst Ben Bajarin shares his perspective on the Duo's software features that help it stand out and how much of the market share it could take from other foldable phones.

title: Apple reveals the foldable iPhone Duo
summary: Apple (AAPL) debuted its first foldable iPhone, named iPhone Duo, with a passport-like design and a starting price of $1,999. The Duo's front has a 5.4-inch display, which can be folded open to a 7.6-inch display.

title: Here's the competition Apple’s foldable iPhone faces
summary: Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley joins Market Catalyst host Julie Hyman to talk about the foldable smartphone market ahead of Apple's (AAPL) product launch and how it will have to contend with Samsung and Huawei's foldable offerings.

title: John Ternus's biggest challenges as Apple's new CEO
summary: Apple's (AAPL) new CEO John Ternus takes center stage today at the company's annual fall event at its Cupertino, Calif., headquarters.

title: Dow Jones Futures: Oil Prices Keep Rising But Market Hasn't Broken Yet. Inflation Data Due.
summary: Oil prices and Treasury yields weighed on the indexes, But Meta, AMD were winners. Apple unveiled its foldable iPhone. Inflation data looms.

title: Forget VUG. Vanguard’s Value Fund Is Beating Its Growth Twin by 11 Points This Year, With None of the Magnificent Seven
summary: Two Vanguard funds share the same large-cap universe, the same rock-bottom fee, and the same issuer, yet one is lapping the other by a stunning margin this year, and the reason comes down to seven stocks you probably already own too many times over.

title: Apple’s iPhone Rally Might Have to Wait
summary: Apple's big tech unveil didn't drum up much enthusiasm for the stock, but the picture tends to get brighter longer-term.  Apple stock fell 0.3% today as it launched a new foldable iPhone.  The stock has done better against the S&P when measured a week after the iPhone launch, outperforming in three of the past five years.

title: Multi-Category Presence Key To AI Visibility For Fintech Brands
summary: Fintech brands face greater challenges gaining visibility in AI-generated answers than brands in other sectors, but rank high when their product offerings span several categories.
